entryPoint: Authenticated parent dashboard > selected child > EYFS activity > Add observation

requirements.requirement: Only authenticated parent or guardian with verified access to the selected child profile can create or read observations
requirements.test: Reject unauthenticated, cross-account and cross-child requests

requirements.requirement: Display the selected child's profile name before entry and require explicit confirmation
requirements.test: Switching profiles cannot carry over an unsaved observation

requirements.requirement: Store child-scoped observation ID, activity ID, status, short note, created and updated timestamps, author ID and review state
requirements.test: Validate every field server-side and reject unknown activities

requirements.requirement: No photos, recordings, public sharing, automatic mastery or child-facing collection
requirements.test: Reject media and mastery flags at API boundary

requirements.requirement: Provide parent review, edit, delete and export with documented retention and erasure behaviour
requirements.test: Deletion removes record from child views and authorised exports

requirements.requirement: Enforce server-side row-level child and household isolation; encrypt in transit and at rest
requirements.test: Cross-household access attempts return no records

requirements.requirement: Accessible labels, keyboard controls, short notes, no compulsory scoring, optional skip and calm neutral feedback
requirements.test: Keyboard and screen-reader review on phone and desktop

requirements.requirement: Present clear parent notice on purpose, lawful basis, retention and rights before first save
requirements.test: No save is possible until approved privacy design is implemented

launchGates: UK GDPR/privacy review and lawful-basis decision
Authentication and ownership checks implemented and tested
Child-scoped database rules and deletion/export tested
End-to-end browser tests on mobile and desktop
